before.harObservation: 30+ individual 1-3 MB PNGs; per-file receive 40-195 s; all requests on one Tailscale HTTP/2 connection

after.cacheControl: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate + ETag (304 on revalidation)
after.webpNegotiation: same .png URL; Content-Type image/webp when Accept lists image/webp and a sibling .webp exists; Vary: Accept

method: Headless Chromium, 1200x800, resource timing buffer 4000, local loopback. 261 texture requests counted. Reload in the same browser context after clearing resource timings. Tailscale throughput and a real PC/phone were not measured.
notes: StarNet artwork is not MIT licensed (NOTICE.md); WebP derivatives are lab-local, gitignored and not published.
The first load still transfers ~38 MB of textures; only repeated loads drop below 1 MB.
JavaScript boot/CPU work remains and is not reduced by these transfer changes.
